notes: Cash (modified cash) basis school district; governmental funds only (school nutrition is a governmental fund). Receipts/disbursements from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (printed p9 = trimmed p3); transfers and fund balances on trimmed p4. The Total column prints blank for interfund transfers (net zero); transfers_in/out recorded as 100,000 each (computed from fund columns: in 100,000 Other Governmental Funds; out 97,375 General + 2,625 Activity). Beginning/ending cash are fund balances (cash and investments plus cash at county treasurers). Balance sheet from the Statement of Activities and Net Position asset/net position section (p2); no liabilities printed. Detail: each fund's Budget and Actual schedule (2025 Actual column; pp 7-22) used as the more detailed schedule; the General Fund Components combining schedule (pp 5-6) is not recorded in detail to avoid double counting. Hidden transfer: the reclassification column (p6) removes 135,000 from Student transportation (state 51,079 and federal 177,814 programs are reclassified wholly into Instruction) as the transfer to the Depreciation Fund (received 135,000, p13); recorded as a contra line in Student transportation and a -135,000 other financing item (review). General Fund printed expenditure total 5,661,642 = line items 5,541,642 - 135,000 contra + 120,000 interfund transfers + 135,000 hidden transfer; General Fund printed revenue total 6,004,679 includes 22,625 transfer in. Budget-only or blank-actual lines omitted (e.g. 1312, 1370, 1925, 4525, 4530 other federal, 2210 actual blank, Cooperative and Student Fee disbursements, Employee Benefit disbursements, QCPU disbursements). Funds with no disbursements have no expenditure total recorded. Read pages 1-22 of 22.
